structured_output.notes: All test suites and smoke scripts strictly adhere to standard library compliance (unittest, sqlite3, urllib, threading, tempfile, http.client). All server tests bind to ephemeral port=0 and use isolated temporary databases with clean teardown. sys.path is dynamically configured to allow importing modules from any execution working directory.
structured_output.summary: Implemented comprehensive stdlib tests for MiniLinks REST API, static asset serving, directory traversal security, SQLite restart persistence, and the 12-step deterministic smoke test script.
